# OpacityCheckerboard { #anylumino.OpacityCheckerboard }

```python
OpacityCheckerboard(width=120, height=48, **kwargs)
```

Display an opacity checkerboard swatch.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type     | Description                                 | Default   |
|--------|----------|---------------------------------------------|-----------|
| width  | optional | CSS width for display-oriented components.  | `120`     |
| height | optional | CSS height for display-oriented components. | `48`      |
